_meta.purpose: Machine-readable source registry for the Steinerne Brücke experience. Consumed by STEINERNE_BRUECKE/js/kframes-gallery.js (loadSources()/resolveFrameSourceText()) to render the restrained QUELLE/SOURCE/FUENTE line on each K-frame caption. Human-readable companion: SOURCES_MASTER.md. Claim-level mapping: CLAIM_SOURCE_MAP.json.
_meta.rule: Every source here was found in existing ZEITSPRUNG project material (ZEITSPRUNG_ACCURACY_RULES.md, MUSEUM_CONTENT_MAP.json, the project's own OCR working transcript, SOURCE_REGISTRY.md). No internet research was performed for this task and no bibliographic detail was invented. Where a field could not be found in project material, it is null.
_meta.id_scheme: Q001, Q002, ... — stable within this monument's SOURCES folder. This is a NEW, monument-scoped ID space, distinct from (but cross-referenced to) the pre-existing cross-monument SB_SRC_00x IDs already registered in 02_CONTENT/SOURCES/SOURCE_REGISTRY.json — see each entry's `cross_reference` field.
